newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: MANAGEMENT BUYS OUT PHILIPS VIDEOLAND CHAIN.
newsitem.headline: MANAGEMENT BUYS OUT PHILIPS VIDEOLAND CHAIN.

text.p: Philips Electronics NV said on Saturday the management of its 187-shop Videoland chain was buying out the video rentals business.
"Videoland was a branch of Superclub which is a branch of Philips. Videoland no longer fit in the strategy of Superclub," said Wilfried Renders, a financial director within Superclub.
He declined to give any financial details of the deal or break down any profit or turnover figures for Superclub.
Superclub is focused on the home entertainments market, selling video games and CD formats. Videoland, with franchise shops around the Netherlands, mainly hires out videos.

Philips on Thursday said it would sell a telecoms equipment maker as part of a restructuring and refocusing of the company's interests announced in October by new chairman Cor Boonstra. -- Amsterdam newsroom +31 20 504 5000, Fax +31 20 504 5040
